capabilities: sync Looki Moments and For You content into date-based daily notes
download and embed images and videos via toggles
configure API key, target folder, media folder, and auto-sync interval
run incremental sync or full resync from commands
rewrite notes idempotently so deletions on Looki are reflected
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Installation currently means cloning the repo, building main.js, and copying files into the vault; the README also contains a checklist for submitting the plugin to the Obsidian community directory. Privacy note: the API key is stored locally in data.json and requests go only to the Looki API and media CDN.
problem: Looki's daily records and AI-generated prompts live in that app, and Obsidian has no built-in way to pull them into dated notes in a vault.

relations.evidence: syncs Looki Moments (daily records) and For You (AI prompts) into date-based daily memory notes
Inspired by the design of Flomo Sync and similar sync plugins

requires.name: Looki service and its media CDN

summary: Syncs Looki Moments and For You AI prompts into date-based daily memory notes, with optional image and video download and embedding.
